d: Batterjee Medical College is seeking qualified and passionate academic professionals to join our Radiological Sciences Department. The successful candidate will contribute to excellence in teaching, research, and community engagement in alignment with BMC’s mission.
r: Prepare and deliver engaging lectures, tutorials, workshops, and seminars.
Develop curricula and course materials suitable for diverse learning platforms.
Collaborate with colleagues to enhance teaching methods and expand knowledge within the field.
Design, assign, and grade assessments, tests, and examinations.
Conduct research, and contribute to scholarly publications, proposals, and academic literature.
Participate in institutional meetings, conferences, and professional events.
Engage in professional development and institutional training initiatives.
Provide academic support and mentorship to students, and contribute to committee work.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge in the field and produce published work.
Education: PhD in Radiological Imaging or a related field such or Radiation Therapy/Treatment , Ultrasound (MSc is the minimum requirement).

Experience: Minimum of 5 years in professional radiographic practice. Previous teaching experience. Track record of published work (preferred). Ability to inspire and engage students. Strong interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills (written and verbal).
Licenses & Certifications: Registration with SCFHS is required.

Play a vital role in upholding the mission and reputation of their institution. Through their research, teaching, and community engagement, they contribute to the institution's academic excellence and its connections with the broader community.

d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

A resort-like sanctuary in Kuwait’s heart. Discover a modern urban sanctuary in the heart of Kuwait City: a contemporary curation of Middle Eastern architecture, dazzling art and resort-like spaciousness, where striking sculptures seamlessly merge with traditional design. In this enclave of wonder – the first and only hotel in Kuwait to receive the prestigious Forbes Five-Star rating – you’ll find soaring rooftop restaurants, leisure facilities and the city’s largest guest rooms. Catch up with friends in the chic surrounds of Al Soor (known as La Chocolaterie of Kuwait), relax in air-conditioned cabanas by the infinity pool, ascend to a buzzing rooftop and wander the lush adjacent parkland. And with the city’s malls and souks within a few minutes’ drive, you can experience all the spoils of the city without spoiling your precious relaxation time.

d: The Senior Account Manager has the responsibility for prospecting and closing new business while managing existing accounts within the assigned MENA territory. With the support of sales engineering, the Senior Account Manager will utilize a consultative and solution-driven sales approach to map OBRELA service offerings to the customers’ needs. In coordination with Regional Sales SVP/VP/Director, he/she executes the sales plan for the assigned MENA territory, ensuring accurate, and efficient sales activities to prospect and close new business and achieve qualified and non-qualified sales goals.
q: Minimum of 8 years’ experience in direct sales/account management in technology, information security or managed service industry
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in selling Managed Security or Managed Detection & Response services.
Knowledgeable about GCC, customers’ security requirements, adopted technologies, industry regulations and business drivers.
Ability to communicate, present and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of an organization.
Strong knowledge about the Managed Security marketplace including MSS, MDR, SIEM, EDR, XDR, NDR, Cloud Security, security controls and practices.
Excellent knowledge about the Managed Security marketplace in particular: MSS, MDR, XDR, EDR, SIEM, NDR, Cloud Security, modern security controls and practices.
Knowledge of Microsoft Security solutions is a plus.
Proven customer management and strategic selling skills that will improve the success of our customers’ business and ensure OBRELA’s business growth
Highly motivated, self-starter, results-driven, and success-oriented with the ability to follow through on commitments and deliver results of the right quality and in a timely fashion.
Interpersonal skills with high energy to earn and keep customer trust and drive business growth.
Strong negotiation skills enabling him/her to effectively close opportunities with the most favorable outcome for OBRELA.
Collaboration skills with the ability to proactively establish and maintain effective working relationships with other OBRELA cross-functional teams.
Proficient in using CRM tools to maintain accurate data for accounts, opportunities, sales activities etc. ensuring accurate sales forecasting.
Strong knowledge of MS Office tools, Sales tools (Salesforce, Cognism etc.), Collaboration tools.
Bachelor’s Degree or higher (Business Administration, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems).
Fluent written & verbal communication skills in English (Arabic a plus)
r: Prospects and sells into Enterprise and Mid-Market accounts in the assigned territory, directly and through partners.
Analyzes the territory and market potential through account planning.
Drives leads generation directly or through sales campaigns in collaboration with marketing.
Targets new customer acquisition and revenue growth.
Qualifies sales opportunities and builds a solid sales pipeline across the assigned territory, directly and through partners.
Delivers face-to-face and on-line meetings and workshops to effectively present and map OBRELA solutions onto customers’ needs.
Develops a deep understanding of customers, partners and competitive landscape, enabling a business dialogue to be conducted with decision makers and their teams.
Has a strong understanding of OBRELA solutions and knows when and how to engage presales/technical assistance.
Demonstrates strong account management capabilities with the ability to identify and close new business opportunities, while managing customer expectations and satisfaction.
Is expected to work closely with Sales Leadership and the wider OBRELA business to provide executive sponsorship for the customer.
Orchestrates the bidding process, drives the proposal write-up, ensures the quality and accuracy of each offering, and manages the proposal submission to customers.

Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including sales engineering, contracts management, sales operations, customer success etc. to optimize results throughout the sales lifecycle and ensure customers’ expectations are met and exceeded.
Provides accurate forecast through CRM. Maintains accurate and detailed data in CRM tools for every prospect interaction.
